SMTO-MEM-0023 — SMTO couldn't safely read a stored file for this document

GUID: 35969f14-e3f3-58c7-bf46-e49fe6d1f4f7
Slug: knowledge-invalid-asset
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • While preparing this document, SMTO found that a stored copy of the file, or an image taken from it, wasn't where it should be. It stopped rather than read from an unexpected place.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Knowledge, on the document select Manage, then Reindex. Reindex reads the file again and makes fresh copies of any images inside it.
  2. If it fails again, select Manage, then Replace, and choose your original file. Replace stores a new, clean copy of the file for SMTO to read.
  3. Select Preview on the document to check its content. Preview shows whether SMTO can now read the stored file.

What success looks like

  • Preview shows the document's content, and the document shows Ready to search.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; they should check SMTO's Knowledge storage folder on the server for links or moved files. Don't move or edit files inside SMTO's data folder yourself.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Knowledge rejected a stored asset path (absolute, containing '..', or resolving through a symlink outside the Knowledge store), or an extracted image path was missing, a symlink, or outside the store root.

What this means

  • The uploaded source asset does not satisfy the expected file or reference checks. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported invalid_asset. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • Preview can read the replacement source.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Check the Knowledge store directory in the user's SMTO state folder for symlinks or relocated files, and the Server log for the document's extraction output. Then Reindex or Replace the document so new assets are written inside the store.
  • Replace the source with a complete supported file and open Preview to check its content.

Retry and execution caution

  • Preview can read the replacement source.

How to verify the fix

  • Preview can read the replacement source.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
